newsitem.title: GERMANY: Upwards trend in German manufacturing has stopped.
newsitem.headline: Upwards trend in German manufacturing has stopped.

text.p: The economics ministry said on Wednesday that the upwards trend in the manufacturing industry, evident by a rise in orders and output from October to November, has come to a standstill.

In its latest economic report, the ministry said data at the end of 1996 showed that although the economy seemed poised for further growth this year there was no clear picture of the economy at the moment.
"The upwards development in manufacturing orders and production which was apparent through October-November has not continued," the ministry said.
The ministry added however that business expectations had improved and that exports were up.
